review.notes: Clean document: no patches. Full read of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 3 physical PDF pages; heading set, section order, all numbers and all words match the printed card, and there are no code fences or flattened tables. Two printed source quirks were deliberately left untouched: the PDF itself misspells 'globabally' on physical p.3 (the OCR transcription reads the corrected 'globally', which is preferable to reintroducing the printed typo) and prints 'SEA=Southeast Asia' with an equals sign, which the OCR transcribes faithfully. The mixed '-'/• bullet glyphs under 'Distribution' follow the PDF's list markers and bullet style is not a defect class.
